opening_state_after_overnight_repairs.note: Includes bounded overnight return from the 11 Jun short-term repair pool; evacuated aircraft are not silently returned to the islands.

doctrine_change: PRESERVE_ATTACK_RECON_CADRE. Area commands no longer feed every serviceable fighter into every US wave. Staged CAP, selective interception, dispersal and westward evacuation take priority over attritional prestige defense.

combat_and_suppression_result.interpretation: Loss rate falls from 11 Jun because Japanese commanders conserve cadres and US raids shift toward suppression/ground targets, but repeated strikes still damage aircraft on dispersal fields and catch some CAP at disadvantage.

end_12Jun.water_aviation: Still dispersed; useful for night/sector reconnaissance but exposed maintenance capacity is degrading.
end_12Jun.repair_outlook: Limited overnight recovery remains possible, but repeated runway/maintenance-area attacks now create cumulative repair backlog.

offensive_response: NO MASS ANTI-CARRIER STRIKE. Night and long-range reconnaissance is preserved; incoming raid bearings still do not give a sufficiently fresh carrier position.
